   16:   The plan (§W10a-112 lines 144-183) pre-registered the header pattern
   17:     `## W1-N <slug> — <status>`  (2-hash level 2; status STRING in header)
   18:   but the actual S80 file `sessions/session-80/session-80-results-workingpaper.md`
